newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed Index unchanged at rvsd 129.5 in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed Index unchanged at rvsd 129.5 in Sept.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said its Chicago Fed Midwest Manufacturing Index (CFMMI) was unchanged for September.
"Midwest manufacturing activity held steady in September as weakness in auto production offset modest gains in other sectors," said the Chicago Fed's report.
The automobile component of the index dipped 0.9 percent in September after two months of strong gains. "Problems with new model roll-outs contributed to the sector's poor showing," the report said.
Both the steel and machinery components of the index rose 0.2 percent in September, while the resources category climbed 0.6 percent.
Manufacturing growth nationwide "increased by a modest 0.2 percent" in September, the report said.
